payload.detail: Authored operator EXPLAIN diagnostic script (scripts/operator-explain-documents-indexes.sql) comparing documents_title_trgm_idx concatenated expression vs bare-column ILIKE predicates on title and file_name. Task stays open until that full sequence completes and is verified.
